newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dlr ends slightly higher on U.S. dlr sales.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dlr ends slightly higher on U.S. dlr sales.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly higher against its U.S. counterpart on Tuesday after greenback profit-taking by foreign commercial banks, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.525 against Monday's T$27.538 close. Turnover through dealers was an active US$281.5 million.
The local dollar remained lower for most of the session on the U.S. currency's strength overseas against the yen.
"But Taiwan dollar buying increased as soon as it (the Taiwan dollar) fell," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
Dealers said they expected the rate to remain bound in a range of T$27.50-55 on Wednesday.
